headline: Magic keyboard in English, name cleanup, less ROM bloat
summary: Major polish round. The ARM9 + UI overlay menu pools are translated for the first time (this is the release that introduced the menu code path v2.31 had to fix the compressed-flag for), 401 dialog-overflow rewrites land, currency unified to "Ritch" everywhere, NPCs have consistent names, and the patched-ROM size drops ~1.57 MB from a build-side dedup fix. This is the largest content drop before the v2.31 stabilization.

msgFileEdits.description: Every msg/onemsg .ofs sub-entry whose text differs between v2.2 and v2.3. Includes new translations (where the previous version still had Japanese or no English) and rewrites (where the English text was changed). Tags like [NPC:1009], [PLAYER_NAME], ▼ (line break), and § (page break) are wire-format control codes — they're shown verbatim, the diff just surfaces the surrounding text changes.

overlayEdits.description: v2.3 is the first release to write English into the ARM9 string pool and the 6 UI overlays that hold the engine-rendered menu / button / prompt text (the strings shown directly by the game, not from message files). Each slot has a fixed byte width — short abbreviations and arrow glyphs ("<<<", "Nxt") are used where the natural English wouldn't fit.

groups.label: ARM9 string pool
groups.note: 26 strings at file offset 0xa6e44 (RAM 0x020a6e44). These slots are populated for the first time in v2.3 with the English menu strings — before v2.3 the slots held no usable text. Slot byte budget = (slot_bytes / 2) - 1 characters because each glyph is 2 bytes UTF-16 LE plus a 2-byte NUL terminator.

groups.label: Overlay 47 — show music
groups.note: Strings in overlay 47. v2.3 wrote English bytes into these slots over the Japanese source. The engine still flagged this overlay as compressed, which is what caused the v2.3 menu crashes — v2.31 fixed the flag without touching the text.
